audit_event_actor_present.name: audit_event_actor_present
audit_event_actor_present.value: "audit_event"."actor_user_id" is not null or nullif("audit_event"."actor_label", '') is not null

audit_event_submission_transition_comple.name: audit_event_submission_transition_complete
audit_event_submission_transition_comple.value: "audit_event"."action" <> 'submission.submitted' or ("audit_event"."state_before" is not null and "audit_event"."state_before" = 'draft' and "audit_event"."state_after" is not null and "audit_event"."state_after" = 'submitted' and "audit_event"."actor_type" = 'human' and "audit_event"."source" is not null and "audit_event"."source" = 'author_workspace' and "audit_event"."correlation_id" is not null)

submission_status_submitted_at_consisten.name: submission_status_submitted_at_consistent
submission_status_submitted_at_consisten.value: ("submission"."status" = 'draft' and "submission"."submitted_at" is null and "submission"."submitted_manuscript_version" is null) or ("submission"."status" in ('submitted', 'under_review', 'revision_requested', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'withdrawn') and "submission"."submitted_at" is not null and "submission"."submitted_manuscript_version" is not null and "submission"."submitted_manuscript_version" > 0)
